## About

Khandokar Riajul Islam is a certified Performance Marketing Specialist & Social Media Manager with 5+ years of hands-on experience. He partners remotely with founders and business owners across the USA, UK, Canada, Singapore, Australia, and the UAE, turning marketing investment into measurable outcomes through Meta Ads, Google Ads, consistent social media management, SEO, and GA4/GTM server-side tracking.

Primary focus: Social Media Management, Meta Ads Management, Google Ads Management.
Supporting capabilities: SEO, Local SEO & ORM, Analytics & Tracking (GA4/GTM), Conversion Optimization (CRO).

- [Local SEO & ORM](/services/local-seo-orm) — Google Business Profile optimization, Google Maps 3-Pack visibility, citation cleanup, and structured 5-star review funnels for Australia & UAE practices.
